notes.title: Steam Scream Festival& Samhain Event - The Death of All Things
notes.notes:
Hey I hope everyone is well, it’s been a while as 2021-2022 was a crazy year. But I am back and working on a whole bevy of new updates.

Today we are celebrating being a part of the Steam Scream Festival with a discount and a special in-game event. The balance of the Gods has shifted, the power of the Goddess of Life has faded away! Leaving yourself and all other enemies as undying piles of meat.

Experience the hidden "Undeath Mode" as the power of the Goddess of Life has faded away.  You can steal meat from others but must protect your own causing all characters to be thrust into a deadly health-point economy where all the health in the game moves to the top, and you'd better hope that's you!


This game mode changes everything about how status effects, melee attacks, your perk loadouts, elemental damage etc etc works! Take advantage of the powers granted to you in this new world to become the ultimate monster!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31510873/31a2bb2ff66cb8625b6b802b0f6fde88b42e1cc1.png[/img]

What's worse is a familiar and powerful demon has seized the throne of the Gods and filled the NEXUS with his Demonic spawn! Find your way to Hastur's throne and you will encounter this mighty usurper.

The Spawn of Michael now fill the dungeon halls stalking you at every turn, can you repel the tide of demons long enough to survive?

notes.title: The Full Moon Is Here! (And Many Other Updates)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510873/8dcdec57b17ae409c83fe3ae992767939251fa0c.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone we've just finished this year's Midsummer event and we are celebrating Shadowcrawl's first ever Full Moon Lunar Event all day today and tomorrow!

As we near the upcoming Shadowcrawl v1.1 update I have been adding so many new features I don't even know where to start so I might as well go with the one I just mentioned first:

[list]

[*] [h1]Lunar Calendar[/h1] [b]Shadowcrawl now tracks the real lunar phase and will run events on nights of high Lunar Activity (full, half, new moons etc).[/b]

[*][h1]Lunar Rituals[/h1] [b]There is a lot of stuff going on during the Lunar events, to the point that it can actually be dangerous to play the game during them:[/b]

[list]
[*] The New Moon - On the night of the New Moon, the Butcher gains the ability to complete his "Undeath Mode" ritual. Upon reaching floor 9 or higher, the player's save data will be altered to activate the dreaded "Undeath Mode." You must then find and kill the Butcher on Floor 10 before the New Moon is over to return your world to normal.

[b][u][i]WARNING[/i][/u][/b]
Should you fail to stop the Butcher before the night is over then the only way to deactivate "Undeath Mode" will be by performing a Dark Ritual at a Fountain of Anima.

[*] The Full Moon - On the night of the Full Moon the corruption level will be high forcing Glitch enemies to run rampant. This does not affect the player save data though.

However should you kill Hastur then the Glitches will stop and give way to much more terrifying occurences. One of several rituals will be selected based on certain player information, each requiring an immediate quest or pilgrimage to prevent.

[*] Avatar of Lunacy - Besides the Glitch enemies there will also be Werewolves running rampant during the full moon.

The Elder Beasts however seek to invoke a cosmic deity mired in Lunar Energy to create a seemingly "Permanent Full Moon" leaving the NEXUS overrun by Lunatics and open to any number of Dark Rituals.

[*] THE END - Upon reaching the Final boss floor "THE END" shall become active, purifying your world and plunging the corruption level. Should you dramatically increase the corruption level you can reverse this ritual. Worshiping Glitches can help.

THE END unleashes the Nightmare creatures of the Void into the world. Leaving the assassin guild legion's of the Walker free to wander between realms.
[/list]

[*] [h1]NEW UNLOCKABLE ITEMS[/h1]
[b]I have programmed a large number of interesting new weapons to the game that can be permanently added to your level generator by completing side-quests and missions. I also rearranged a few weapons and armor for balance's sake.[/b]

[list]
[*] Moved Elvira's Breastplate from the default item pool to unlockable
[*] Moved Pulse Tower Shield from the default item pool to unlockable
[*] Added Twisted Thornwood Shield
[*] Added Burst Buckler
[*] Added Cowl of Hollowing
[*] Added Plasma Bubble
[*] Added Phoenix Fists
[*] Added Slip Cloak
[*] Added Blight Bug
[*] Added Hallowed Circlet

All of these items can be unlocked by completing quests and then going out to find them in Gold Chests within the dungeon

[/list]

[*][h1] Quest Updates[/h1]
[b]I've also been adding new quests and improving upon existing ones.[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Floor 5 "Renegade Knight" Quest
[*] Added "Yog Mystery" to Floor 5 which drops a severed head
[*] Guaranteed Sacrificial Altar Spawn during Floor 5 Quest
[*] Added Raz to the Floor 5 Quest at the Spawn Point
[*] Added Floor 15 "Michael" Quest
[*] Made Michael Semi-Invincible once freed until completing his quest
[*] Added Raz to Floor 15 Michael Quest
[*] Added Tlacelel as an ally during Walker Boss Battle
[*] Added secret Ally to the Hastur Boss Battle if the player has the Blade of Psyche in their inventory.

[b]Many of these changes render the Guide here on Steam slightly obsolete so I will be updating and finishing it soon with the new content.[/b]
[/list]

[*][h1] New Endgame Content[/h1]
[b]Much hidden content in Shadowcrawl is buried in the Endgame and I'm excited to say I have been adding even more, especially with the focus of "Second Plays":[/b]

[list]
[*] Traveling to all of the 5 main shrines with a character will cause that character to start out in the the “Cult of the Holy Pilgrims” on future runs.
[*] New Cult "Abjurers of the Throne" added to all save files after completing the final boss battle with any character.
[*] Eventually I’ll split this Cult into 3 versions based on what your most recent ending was.
[*] Floors 25-30 are now a special new biome with unique enemies and a secret boss on floor 30.
[*] I’ve almost finished implementing 3 new endings that can be triggered if you beat the game with a second character.
[/list]

[*][h1] Lives System[/h1]
[b]A new system is in place that rewards skillful play by awarding the player “Lives.” Lives let you keep your gear upon death and can be accumulated up to a certain amount. ONLY EQUIPPED ITEMS will be passed on to the next character and nothing else.

Also per the staggering demand for it, a “Hardcore” Perma-Death mode is on its way.[/b]

[*][h1] Minor Updates[/h1]
[b]Penultimately I’ve been fixing little things and making small improvements all over the place, here are some of them:[/b]

[list]
[*] I guess it’s not so minor but I have basically rebalanced everything in the game and how many of the stats work including armor.
[*] I’ve also made it so having a weapon equipped that has the same ability as your default skill will enhance your default skill. For example flames will reach 3 tiles if an engineer equips a Fire Tome.
[*] I’ve added pop-up text that notifies the player when they unlock secret items, bosses, or allies.
[*] Dramatically improved the look of the portals. I tried to make them look distinct in a way that indicated to the player that the portal may have some effect on the challenge level of their destination.
[*] For Example the Red Portals are now very scary looking to signify they will dramatically increase the difficulty level of the game (the dungeon “intensity” level to be specific).
[*] Made it so isolated wall tiles becomes columns/pillars
[*] General restructuring to level generation
[*] Implemented “Patterns” to level generation which help tell caverns to have large areas and spires to have long hallways.

[/list]

[i][b]And I want to end this update with information about the Dream cause it’s a pretty unusual mechanic.[/b][/I]

[*][h1] Enlightenment & The Dream[/h1]
[b]Another effect that results from visiting all 5 main shrines is the player becomes “Enlightened.” Enlightenment offers several benefits but mostly it interacts heavily with The Dream System I have implemented.

At any moment you may be several layers deep in a dream, occasionally the outside world will “END” and a certain in-game character forces everyone a layer deeper into the dream.

While in a dream, Enlightenment causes players to become aware of the Dream Wardens who will be immediately hostile once detected. Mostly there is no way to tell if you are in a dream and how deep. Worshipping a specific God affects the Dream Level by placing you deeper but unenlightened characters would be entirely without a means to determine this.

I’m also not sure what happens if you break out of the dream or the specific conditions that trigger it or allow you to escape. This is all stuff I hooked up to the many in-game calendars years ago but never fully implemented until recently, so the whole thing is largely automated.[/b]

[/list]

Anyways that’s all for now, thanks a ton everyone who made it this far and don’t forget to check us out on twitter for more frequent updates or to visit the discord to leave me some feedback!

[b]
Reach out to me on Twitter -> www.twitter.com/Shadow_Crawl 
Email -> AlexOsuna@gmail.com
And on our discord channel -> https://discord.gg/AsX9uZb

We also have a Wiki you can check out! -> shadowcrawl.wikia.com/wiki/ShadowCrawl_Wikia

And there is more information about the game on our website www.wickedcakegames.com/shadowcrawl.html
[/b]

notes.title: Shadowcrawl Samhain Event!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510873/7c00393c5159806dc5aeef119dc2ad934216c3d1.jpg[/img]

Happy Samhain everybody and welcome back! I'm excited to announce that Shadowcrawl is in the heat of its holiday event.

The infamaous "Undeath Mode" has been activated, turning everyone everywhere into piles of undead meat and thrusting the world into a "Eat or be Meat" economy where all of the health moves to the top (which had better be you).

I've made a huge number of changes with these updates and I'll try to go through a number of them while I'm here

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where stun potions didn't work without a weapon equipped.
[*] Added a system for selecting ally skills during combat, allowing users with a party to effectively attack twice in one turn.
[*] Added the character "Roz" to the Butcher stage.
[*] Made the butcher stage act differently while undeath mode is active.
[*] Made the nature of "Meat Worship" change while undeath mode is active.
[*] Added Rsi to the Shogoth level if you've completed her escort quest.
[*] Added Miya to Shub Nug's stage if you've completed her escort quest
[*] Fixed a bug where the Demon Michael was invincible and would one-shot players
[*] Adjusted the text-boxes to a more user friendly location on screen
[*] Added general updates to the functionality of the Samhain event
[/list]

Anyways I'm usually forgetting something but don't worry there will be an entirely new slew of features in the game in the next version too so be sure to keep checking it out and as always feel free to give me any feedback, ideas or suggestions you all might have.

Thanks again everyone for playing, I hope you enjoy the Holiday!

notes.title: Major Updates Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510873/3c55ddc35bdbbbe1fe487bfa2e52d2d89c05c9f3.png[/img]

How's it going everybody? it's been a couple months since launch and I'm really excited to see you all enjoying the game so much. It is definitely a huge passion project to me and something I made just because enjoy playing it so much so it really brings me joy to see that so many other people feel the same way I do about Shadowcrawl.

As some of you may have noticed, there has been a constant stream of updates to the game since launch so here I will go into some of the features and fixes that were included in the updates.

[h1][u][b]Shadowcrawl Post Launch Updates[/b][/u][/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Changed how most consumable items work.[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the Flame Scrolls to shoot a ranged fireball spell.
[*] Changed the Stun Potion to be throwable up to 8 tiles.
[*] Removed the throwing spike and replaced it with a deployable stun trap.
[/list]

[*][b]Adjusted all of the stats for all 10 of the Base Mini-Boss enemies (Blood God, Creeping Willow, Goblin King etc).[/b]

[*][b]Adjusted Health Stat to Hit Point ratios increasing them for all characters ever so slightly.[/b]

[*][b]Dramatically altered how Armor Rating and Defense relate to Damage reduction. Nearly doubling it for Barrier Protection and increasing it somewhat for Health Protection. This has resulted in players being able to manage larger crowds as their Defense hits extreme values later in the game.[/b]

[*][b]Performed dramatic general balance fixes all across the board in an attempt to make the combat feel better.[/b]

[*][b]Added the Trophy System to the Game as well as the first 5 boss trophies and a sub-menu to interface the trophies that can be accessed from the inventory screen.[/b]

[*][b]If you acquire a trophy on a level it now shows you what trophy you've earned at the end of that level.[/b]

[*][b]The secret endings used to only depend on player alignment, I've changed them to also require all 5 boss trophies.[/b]

[*][b]I made it so lone wall tiles in the maze without any neighbors will be replaced by a "Pillar" graphic specific to the current floor's Wall Biome. This really adds visually to the levels as well as changing the flow of rooms within the dungeon.

[*][b]I changed the Lady of Blades to appear at the player spawn point on floors where the "Goblin Uprising" quest are available. This flows a lot better in terms of story and provides the player some combat support for the quest as well as a warning of what lies in wait for them.[/b]

[*][b]I have done the same thing with the Lady of Blades on floors where the "Refute Thy Fealty" quest is available. This provides a much needed warning about the high levels of difficulty that lie ahead as well as how dramatically you will forever alter your game world.[/b]

[*][b]I intend to do this for all late game quests in future updates.[/b]

[*][b]Killing The Butcher now unleashes new Cult Shrines and secret enemies into the game world. Specifically releasing the Demon Michael and adding shrines of Demon and Meat worship to the level generator.[/b]

[*][b]On that note I have added new forms of Meat and Demon Worship to the game.[/b]
[list]
[*]After Killing the Butcher:
[list]
[*] Players can find a non aggressive Michael and worship him to gain the Demon perk without sacrificing an NPC.
[*] Players can find Meat Altars to gain the Undeath Perk and Blood Bath spell.
[/list]

[*] Players can also create their own meat altar by placing 7 severed heads on the floor into a pile together. This can be done without having killed The Butcher yet.
[/list]

[*][b]Fixed the infamous "Compass Bug" which would cause the compass to fail after several floors.[/b]

[*][b]Fixed transparency issues with the ending cinematic sequences. [/b]

[*][b]Some enemies had the forbidden-perk "Double-Step" left over from when I balanced it out of the game. I've managed to remove it entirely (I think). [/b]

[/list]

Anyways again I'm really grateful to see you all so interested in the game and I can't wait to hear what everyone thinks about all the feature additions. Keep an eye out for more update logs coming too as I am constantly adding fresh and fun new features to the game.

I also post most of the changes I make to Twitter on a much more regular basis so you should follow me if you want fresh news on fresh changes.

I really enjoy feedback and love to hear from users so if any of you have any suggestions, ideas or general comments please feel free to reach out to me through any of my many means of contact. I will also be much more active on the discussion boards moving forwards.

Anyways thanks everyone for playing and I hope to hear from you all soon!

[b]
Reach out to me on Twitter -> www.twitter.com/Shadow_Crawl 
Email -> AlexOsuna@gmail.com
And on our discord channel -> https://discord.gg/AsX9uZb

We also have a Wiki you can check out! -> shadowcrawl.wikia.com/wiki/ShadowCrawl_Wikia

And there is more information about the game on our website www.wickedcakegames.com/shadowcrawl.html
[/b]
